evidence_sentence: The function checks for the presence of device and target indices in the attributes.
rationale: The fixed implementation validates both NFC_ATTR_DEVICE_INDEX and NFC_ATTR_TARGET_INDEX before reading either. The vulnerable implementation validates only the device index and unconditionally reads the target index. Thus, the Logic section specifically describes the fixed-only target-index presence check.
rewritten_docstring: The function obtains the device and target indices from the attributes. It retrieves the device using the device index and deactivates the target using the target index. Finally, it releases the device reference and returns the result of the deactivation operation.
